purpose: Independent supplementary proofs for observed foundation purity and current-evidence boundaries. Additive; never substitutes or changes the original frozen acceptance.
scope: Cold DrawerStore(read_only=True) rejects missing-parent, missing-file and outdated schema stores without creation, migration or file changes.
Real CLI task path bypasses registration and background update hooks; pending banners cannot break complete stdout budget; missing and existing homes remain identical.
Cold and warm FastEmbedProvider.embed_query_readonly calls use isolated cached assets with networking forbidden and no cache/log/file changes.
Current secret and suspicious successors suppress stale predecessors; a withheld branch remains an explicit unresolved conflict without secret text or source metadata.
snapshot_contract: Whole isolated tree including root/directory mtimes and file mtimes plus SHA-256. Includes DB sidecars, caches and logs; directory timestamps also detect transient file creation/removal.
infrastructure: Actual model gate requires CAIRNTIR_ACCEPTANCE_MODEL_CACHE. Missing cached assets are INCONCLUSIVE, never skip/xfail or semantic PASS.
manifest_self_hash: External SHA-256 supplied to coordinator; excluded from its own inventory.
